about.title: About Me
about.description: Full stack developer with 4+ years of experience building enterprise applications for the banking and consulting industries. Specialized in Angular, TypeScript, and Node.js, with hands-on experience in serverless architectures (AWS Lambda), process automation (RPA), and CI/CD pipelines. Currently leading development teams at TCS, setting technical standards and delivering scalable solutions.

tcsLead.title: Technical Lead
tcsLead.description: Leading a team of developers in the architecture and delivery of enterprise web applications with Angular and Node.js. Setting technical standards, managing CI/CD pipelines, and overseeing SQL/NoSQL database design for large-scale clients.

tcsDev.title: Developer
tcsDev.description: Development of serverless architectures with AWS Lambda and automation of business processes with Power Automate for banking sector clients. Full software lifecycle management using Azure DevOps.

kpmgMiddle.title: Mid-Level RPA Developer
kpmgMiddle.description: Design and development of RPA bots with Automation Anywhere to automate audit and consulting processes. Creation of complementary scripts in Python and JavaScript for data integration and report generation.

kpmgJunior.title: RPA Developer
kpmgJunior.description: Building automation bots with Automation Anywhere for repetitive tasks in banking processes. Business flow modeling in Bizagi and SQL queries for data extraction and validation.
